title: haptic.cue
description: host → server → client (relayed unchanged). Asks phones to vibrate with a named pattern. Phones ignore it when the device preference haptics is false or the device has no vibration.

to.description: Players to cue; null = every player (spectators never).

HapticCue.description: Phone vibration cue (§15). The vibration pattern for each cue is defined in the client.

PlayerId.description: Player identifier, unique within a room and never reused: "p" followed by a positive integer (p1, p2, …).
